# time_s: # CppBedrock SBFT: election (view-change) timeout and slow-path (fast-path wait) timeout.
# Best pair per phase of config/sbft/failure_spec.xml
# boundary so the change lands before the regime does. Calibrated at 15
# requests/s on CloudLab with the consensus window at 64 batches in flight
# on the agent's own reward averaged over episodes; see CppBedrock/adaptive_timers.MD.
# Election timeouts: 250 (low)
#   phase                          acceptable        labelled   why
#   t=0    base                    all three         250        nothing elects; low is no worse
#   t=300  base + delay 230        low               250        D+tail=397: only 250 fires
#   t=600  base + delay 700        low or medium     250        D+tail=867: 600 fires too; 1200 pays
#   t=900  5+50                    medium or high    600        250 is under the 319 ms tail
#   t=1200 5+50 + delay 500        medium            600        D+tail=819: 600 fires
#   t=1500 5+150                   high              1200       250 and 600 are under the 624 ms tail
# Two mechanisms
election_timeout_ms: kept separate. The network delay sets the healthy latency tail

# time_s: # and a rung at or below its level's tail storms on ordinary latency - that is
# what removes the low rung at 5+50 and both lower rungs at 5+150
# injected at all. The leader proposal delay decides which of the surviving rungs
# fires: above D + tail a timeout never reaches its deadline and pays the delay on
# every request
election_timeout_ms: below it the timeout escapes to a clean leader once per 60 s tick.

# time_s: # Raising the delay brings the next rung up into play; it does not push the winner
# higher. So 5+150 carries no delay - its tail alone leaves only the high rung.
# Where a phase accepts more than one value
election_timeout_ms: the lower is labelled: it is no worse

# time_s: # in that phase and it keeps the trajectory's changes tied to the regime changes.
# The medium rung sits near the top of its band (319 < 600 < 624) to leave the
# widest gap above the low rung
